statement_summary: Written information security program with an index of its parts
Qualified Individual designated in writing
Annual written risk assessment with the 314.4(b)(1) criteria
Annual independent assessment; penetration test and six-month vulnerability assessments
Annual written report to the Partner Group
Service provider due diligence, contract terms, and annual assessment
Written IRC 6713 and 7216 notice to contractor staff before access
Sanctions for security and confidentiality violations
Unique accounts; shared mailboxes only through delegated access
Role-based least privilege; team-based client folder access
MFA for everyone; number matching; hardware keys for administrators; legacy protocols blocked
Mandatory client portal MFA; call-back before client MFA reset
Same-day disable at termination; seasonal end dates
Quarterly access reviews; monthly admin review
Separate administrator accounts; two break-glass accounts
Remote access through VPN or SSO with MFA; MSP tool restricted; no access from outside the United States without approval
Written incident response plan covering 314.4(h)(1)-(7)
Report suspected incidents immediately and within 1 hour
Record the discovery date that starts the FTC clock
Meet notification deadlines (IRS next business day, FTC 30 days, Florida 30 days)
Freeze refund bank, address, and email changes during a suspected compromise
Annual tabletop before filing season; lessons learned within 30 days
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; no plain attachments
Inventory of Restricted data locations and recipients, including AI sub-processors
Disclose tax return information only as 301.7216-2 permits or with prior written consent
Dispose of customer information within two years of last use unless the schedule requires longer
Certified destruction; printer-scanner drives wiped before lease return
Immutable encrypted backups restore-tested quarterly
No Restricted data in AI tools without approval and a confirmed IRC 7216 basis
Training before access and annually; phishing exercises at least quarterly
Call-back verification for bank, address, and email changes
Approved generative AI tools only; human review of AI output
Access client files only as work requires; access is logged and reviewed
